description: Create a contact, or update the one that already has this phone number. Only the fields you pass are changed; fields you leave out keep their current values. Tags are added to the contact's existing tags, never removed.

name.description: Optional name, used for {{name}} in send_broadcast.

notes.description: Optional notes. Replaces any existing notes.

phone.description: The contact's phone number, which identifies the contact. Use E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567). A number without a country code is read in the country of the phone's SIM.

name: save_contact
title: Create or update a contact
